reason: All key premises are directly supported by the single cited study (E1, E2, E3), which demonstrates the cooling-rate effect, strain distribution, crack deflection, and property improvements in an SLM-processed HEA. However, the evidence is from one alloy system and one temperature (650°C), so the claimed temperature range (up to 982°C) and broad applicability across HEA compositions are overstatements not yet supported.
